artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan resolving a linked git worktree to its parent checkout for Sapience MCP registration, slug derivation, and verification, with worktree regression coverage and a domain-note record of the deliberate hook-channel absence.

memory_candidates.content: When a helper block is needed by a script that is INSTALLED to a stable user-level path (e.g. a SessionStart hook copied to ~/.claude/hooks/ so it works in a repo with no deploy tree), prefer inlining the block over sourcing a shared library -- a library becomes a third file the installer must copy, and a partially-updated install (old installer, new consumer) breaks a surface whose contract promises never to fail. The duplication cost is then converted into a mechanically checked invariant rather than a prose 'keep in lockstep' comment: bracket each copy with a begin/end marker comment pair and add a regression case that extracts the marker-delimited block from every copy and asserts byte-identity, naming the divergent file on failure. This generalizes any existing prose lockstep promise between two files into a test.
